text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Fascinating! Truly fascinating! To think I'd come this far to have my research refuted!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do some thinking! Based on the results…
choice_data_list: Take your time and think it through.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: What?! I may be excited but that doesn't mean I'm panicking!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, I should calm myself. I can't come to make sound decisions if my head's not clear.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: There's time. We surely have time left. Best to make the most of it!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh. I swear, I will certainly overcome this obstacle!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Come now! There is value in worrying!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: This failure will serve as fuel to search for a way forward!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: My research up till now hasn't all been for naught. I'm sure the answer is hidden in there somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Listen to me, Trainer. I will find the answer!
